text:
Peregrine Lens has acquired Fennimore Optics in a transaction valued at $412 million in cash and stock, the companies announced on 14 March 2031.

Delphine Okonkwo-Hale, Chief Executive Officer of Peregrine Lens, confirmed the deal. The purchase is described in a joint press release issued by the two companies and in a regulatory filing submitted to the Halvern Trade Commission, Filing No. HTC-31-0227.

The Continental Record has relied on those two documents for the terms reported here. The filing records the acquisition and its stated value. The press release sets out the companies' joint announcement of the agreement.

Neither document, as reviewed by this newspaper, provides further financial detail beyond the combined cash-and-stock valuation. Any additional terms of the transaction were not part of the material cited.

Fennimore Optics becomes part of Peregrine Lens under the agreement announced this week.
